offer.service: Help privately held and family-owned business owners sell, transition, or plan succession from valuation through closing.
offer.audience: Owners of privately held and family-owned businesses considering an eventual sale or succession.
offer.cta: Would a confidential outline of the process be useful?

cta_variants.text: Would a confidential outline of the process be useful?
Should I send over a short succession-planning outline?
Would it help to see how the process typically works?
Open to a confidential overview of the options?

approved_claims: Chapman Associates has more than 70 years of experience.
Chapman Associates has a network of more than 8,500 buyer relationships.
The process can cover valuation through closing.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim the owner intends to sell, that a buyer is waiting, that the business is off-market, or that an outcome is guaranteed.

personalization.objective: Use a verified company focus to ask a hypothetical continuity question without implying sale intent.

templates.subject: {{company_short_name}} continuity
templates.pitch: If ownership changed years from now, what would need protecting about {{company_focus}}?

templates.subject: Future plans for {{company_short_name}}
templates.pitch: Have you documented how {{company_focus}} should carry through a future ownership transition?
